_comment: Registry for scripts/mcp-lazy.py. Each MCP server in .mcp.json starts as a lazy stub that exposes one tool, `start`. The backend process below is launched only when an agent calls that tool. `summary` and `use_when` are shown to the agent in the tool description so it can decide whether the task needs the server; `instead` names a cheaper route that needs no MCP at all. `env_fallback` maps a required variable to a resolver in mcp-lazy.py (ENV_FALLBACKS) that is used only when the variable is unset.

paper-assistant.summary: folio-assistant platform server: corpus_search / search_graph over the knowledge graph (folio/ + library/), document rendering, QA and workflow tools (~70 tools).
paper-assistant.use_when: you need several graph or platform tools interactively in one session. For a single corpus-grep step 0, the CLI is enough.
paper-assistant.instead: bun scripts/corpus-search.ts "<topic>" (same function, same roots, no MCP).
paper-assistant.cost: about 3-10 s; needs the FULL platform (scripts/setup-folio-assistant.sh, 1.7 GB). The light platform installed by the SessionStart hook cannot run it.

lean-lsp.summary: lean-lsp-mcp: Lean diagnostics, goal states, hover, completions, LeanSearch / Loogle / Lean Finder, axiom check.
lean-lsp.use_when: you are iterating a Lean proof and want goal states or Mathlib search. For verifying a finished file, lean-direct is the gate.
lean-lsp.instead: lean -DautoImplicit=false -s 65536 <file> against the restored olean tree (AGENTS.md, 'VERIFY a single file with lean-direct').
lean-lsp.cost: about 1-2 s once uv has cached the package; the first run downloads it. The LSP itself needs restored oleans to answer quickly.

paper-search-mcp.summary: paper-search-mcp: search arXiv, PubMed, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar and others; download PDFs.
paper-search-mcp.use_when: you need to find or fetch an external paper that is not in library/.
paper-search-mcp.instead: check library/INDEX.md and library/*/sections first (corpus-grep path 5).
paper-search-mcp.cost: about 5-30 s on first run (uv resolves the package).

openalex-paper-search.summary: alex-mcp: OpenAlex author and work search (citations, affiliations, ORCID).
openalex-paper-search.use_when: you need bibliographic metadata from OpenAlex (author disambiguation, citation counts).
openalex-paper-search.instead: the paper-search-mcp server, or the CSL-JSON in folio/references/ for works already cited.
openalex-paper-search.cost: about 5-30 s on first run (uv builds the package from git). OPENALEX_MAILTO falls back to the repo owner's email, read from git history at start time and never written to the repo (owner, 2026-11-20).
